opening.argument: The presentation opens as a daily crypto market update and focuses on reported RAVE price activity and DeFi exploits. The speaker says viewers had previously been warned about RAVE, relays an allegation of pump-and-dump activity, and describes how unbacked collateral reportedly created bad debt on lending platforms. These are accounts of market events and risks, not promises of an investment return. When discussing DeFi supply rates, the speaker explicitly cautions against entering DeFi right now. The evidence supports a market-analysis purpose without establishing any viewer losses or outcome.
